channel.title: Bill Breakdown
channel.description: What laws passed by Congress actually do, explained from the Congressional Research Service summaries, with no spin. Every claim traceable to the bill text. This podcast explains laws in plain language and is not legal, tax, or financial advice.
channel.itunes:author: Bill Breakdown

item.title: Bill Breakdown: The HALT Fentanyl Act
item.description:
Alex and Jordan explain the HALT Fentanyl Act (P.L. 119-26), which permanently places fentanyl-related substances as a class in Schedule I, aligns their mandatory minimums with the fentanyl-analogue thresholds, and streamlines Schedule I research registration. Fentanyl itself remains Schedule II.
Sources: Bill page (CRS summary): https://www.congress.gov/bill/119th-congress/senate-bill/331/all-info | Full law text (P.L. 119-26): https://www.congress.gov/119/plaws/publ26/PLAW-119publ26.pdf

item.title: Bill Breakdown: The License to Drill Act
item.description:
Alex and Jordan explain the License to Drill Act (P.L. 119-134), a one-page law that extends the Bureau of Land Management's drilling permit application fee through 2037 and keeps the money flowing to the fund that pays the staff who process the permits: what the fee is, where the money goes, why the authority almost expired, and what the law does not change.
Sources: Bill page (CRS summary): https://www.congress.gov/bill/119th-congress/house-bill/7831/all-info | Full law text (P.L. 119-134): https://www.congress.gov/119/plaws/publ134/PLAW-119publ134.pdf

item.title: Bill Breakdown: The Romance Scam Prevention Act
item.description:
Alex and Jordan explain the Romance Scam Prevention Act, which requires online dating services to warn members who received messages from an account later banned for fraud, what those warnings must say, and why they are not required until October 20, 2027.
Sources: Bill page (CRS summary): https://www.congress.gov/bill/119th-congress/house-bill/2481/all-info | Full law text (P.L. 119-129): https://www.congress.gov/119/plaws/publ129/PLAW-119publ129.pdf

item.title: Bill Breakdown: The TAKE IT DOWN Act
item.description:
Alex and Jordan explain the TAKE IT DOWN Act, which makes publishing nonconsensual intimate images and digital forgeries a federal crime and requires covered platforms to remove reported images within forty-eight hours.
Sources: Bill page (CRS summary): https://www.congress.gov/bill/119th-congress/senate-bill/146/all-info | Full law text (P.L. 119-12): https://www.congress.gov/119/plaws/publ12/PLAW-119publ12.pdf

item.title: Bill Breakdown: The Social Security Fairness Act
item.description:
Alex and Jordan explain how the Social Security Fairness Act repealed two rules that shrank benefits for retired teachers, firefighters, police officers, and other public workers.
Sources: CRS background: https://www.congress.gov/crs_external_products/IN/PDF/IN12451/IN12451.3.pdf | Bill page and text: https://www.govtrack.us/congress/bills/118/hr82

item.title: Bill Breakdown: The GENIUS Act
item.description:
Alex and Jordan explain the GENIUS Act, the first federal law for stablecoins, from who may issue them to the one-to-one reserve rules and when the law takes effect.
Sources: Bill page (CRS summary): https://www.congress.gov/bill/119th-congress/senate-bill/1582/all-info | Full law text (P.L. 119-27): https://www.congress.gov/119/plaws/publ27/PLAW-119publ27.pdf

item.title: Bill Breakdown: The One Big Beautiful Bill Act
item.description:
Alex and Jordan explain what the One Big Beautiful Bill Act actually does, from the tax changes to Medicaid and food assistance, based on Congressional Research Service summaries and Congressional Budget Office estimates.
Sources: Bill page (CRS summary): https://www.congress.gov/bill/119th-congress/house-bill/1/all-info | Full law text (P.L. 119-21): https://www.congress.gov/119/plaws/publ21/PLAW-119publ21.pdf
